translations.web: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
translations.bsb: He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household, but he who hates bribes will live.
translations.kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
translations.asv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth bribes shall live.
